text_block_list.text:
Before the race. When I headed to the 
waiting room to call Verxina, what leaped 
into my view was—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
choice_data_list: Ngh... We still have a little more time.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's save our energy for the actual 
event, then.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To etch my name as a queen, I want to 
approach every single race with everything 
I have...!
